title: TokenStack: A Heterogeneous HBM-PIM Architecture and Runtime for Efficient LLM Inference
selection_reason: HBM4 stackをdense capacity layerとPIM-enabled layerへ垂直分離し、logic base dieでKV移動・address translation・gather/broadcast・inline quantizationを管理する。topology-aware placement、workload-aware eviction、bounded replicationでhot KVだけをnear-memory computeへ寄せ、production-derived traceでAttAcc比token throughput 1.62倍、SLO capacity 1.70倍、energy 30〜47%削減を報告する。
